item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: The Costa Rica service team is selling little Caesars pizza kits until the end of this weekend. Please remember to submit your order online by this coming Sunday.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Remembrance Day ceremonies are fast approaching. If you are a cadet, and would like to participate in the flag party, please come to the chaplaincy office to sign up.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: We are creating a new display in the front display case for the festival of the day of the dead. You are invited to bring to Mr. Vonesch a picture of a loved one who has died which will be displayed along with flowers and traditional Mexican decorations for this popular and culturally significant day. Please submit pictures to Mr. Vonesch before next Wednesday, October 28.

item.title: A message from Ms Dawson:
item.description: Could all WEB crew members helping with the student municipal election meet Ms Dawson in the 7/8 Resource room immediately after announcements?

item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: Congratulations to the junior girls' basketball team for their convincing win yesterday against Le Sommet in what becaome a pretty chippy game in the 2nd half. After a bit of a slow start the Ravens locked down on defense and were able to shut down Le Sommet. Please wish them good luck as they are off to the Arnprior Refrew tournament and play Carelton Place High School and Holy Trinity from Cornwall in pool play today.

item.title: A message from Ms. Baron and Ms.Clune:
item.description: A reminder to all junior and senior boys interested in playing basketball this season, we will have our second tryout after school today from 2:30-4. Please make sure you have a ride home.

item.title: A message from Ms. Baron:
item.description: Want to treat a friend? We will be selling Ghosty-Grams for $2 during High School lunch today, as well as next Tuesday and Wednesday. Bring your toonies!

item.title: A message from Ms. McMartin:
item.description: Thank you to those 7/8 students who signed up for the BCC Math Contest on Thursday, November 12th. Ms. McMartin is trying to finalize our registration, and today is the last day to make changes. If you have changed your mind, and no longer wish to participate, you must tell Ms. McMartin ASAP.

item.title: A message from Mme. Plourde:
item.description: There will be a meeting for all WEB members in room 146 at 9:05 am. Thank you!

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Longval
item.description: Just a reminder for students in grades 9-12 interested in joining the STA HYROX Fitness Team! Sign-up sheets are posted on the bulletin board outside the gym foyer, next to the vending machine. An information meeting will take place on Tuesday, October 27th, at 11:00 AM during lunch in the weight room for all interested students. If you have any questions, please send Mrs. Longval a message through Microsoft Teams, as she is away today with the Varsity Football Team.
